notes.title: Update 17.19 Is Here!
notes.content:
Update 17.19 Is Here!

Good news, players! The final two levels of Expeditions are now available.

In the fourth mission, your task is to protect an ally outpost from enemy attacks. To enter this mission, make sure you've conquered the boss in sector 10.

The fifth mission is a real test of skill. A massive boss awaits you. To gain access, you need to have defeated at least five bosses in highly active areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/c68845e7a8c7263cab7332730cffba1d9a2b6d99.png[/img]

This update marks the final content addition. However, I'll continue to make updates to fix any errors. Im excited as we're nearly at version 1.0, which is going to be packed with surprises and new features! I appreciate the support from all our players. I'll be keeping you in the loop about changes in the final version and looking forward to your valuable feedback.

Im not revealing anything just yet!

A big thank you to everyone, and i hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 0.16.19
notes.content:
New window mode!

The window mode option has been added. However, due to the wide variety of monitors, resolutions and configurations, this option may still require modifications.

Please, if you have problems implementing it, report it so we can continue improving.

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Update 0.16.18
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

A bug was fixed that could cause multiple instances to overlap when selecting a weapon, making it impossible to choose the desired one.

An error was corrected where the player could, in unlimited mode, chase the cargo ship, causing the level to never start.

The speed increase upgrade was replaced with a greater angle of rotation upgrade.

Now in sector 7, the clouds that give electric shocks will no longer cause damage during mineral discharge, only during collection.

notes.title: Fixes 0.16.17
notes.content:
Fixed an error that caused the player to disappear if the game was paused right at the start in Expeditions.

Fixed an error that did not allow changing the music in level 3 of Expeditions.

In the new mode, visual elements were added to give more life to the stage.

Also, when the player destroys a base, the remaining ones will be more resistant, making it more consistent with the level increase.

notes.title: Update 0.16.17 is underway!
notes.content:
We're introducing a new mission in expeditions: "GROUND DEFENSE ATTACK"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/cccb65ec6291868658e050ce1d0d854ec04356ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/e7982cd9be09bf574bd206af2da624f470ef67bc.png[/img]

In this bold adventure, your objective will be to dismantle three defense bases on the surface of a desolate desert planet. It won't be a walk in the park, but don't worry, you're not against the clock on this one. However, remember there's a leaderboard waiting for you at the end of the tunnel, so try to complete it as quickly as possible to show off your skills!

We eagerly look forward to you enjoying this new content. And as always, we are eager to hear your feedback and suggestions. Your feedback is the fuel that powers the engine of EON Fighter.

A big thank you to all of you, our incredible gaming community! Until the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.15.17
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused not all icons to be visible in the mission selection menu.

In high activity sectors, you can now see this in the interface during the game.

Players can no longer shoot at Bosses during the introduction.

For each sector, the amount of money obtained increases by 10%. In this way, the higher the sector, the greater the earnings.

Damage received by the player can now be seen in yellow.

If the player completes the charge and still has time on the timer, they will receive a money bonus for each remaining second.

And finally, at the request of some players, you can now shoot with the C key or CTRL, in addition to the left click. Apparently, the sound of the click attracts a lot of attention when they want to play in places where they shouldn't. (͠≖ ͜ʖ͠≖)👌

notes.title: Update 15.16
notes.content:

I have performed a significant review of the balance of the main weapons. The goal is to ensure that all weapons are competitive and viable. For this reason, I have modified the damage, significantly increasing those that were insufficient.

Feedback from our players is vital to find the perfect balance. I invite you to share your opinions with me. Have you noticed the improvements? Do you think the game is now more balanced?

I appreciate your support and comments. Thank you!

notes.title: Update 0.14.14
notes.content:
Update 0.14.14

Hello! I'm Nicolas, the developer of EON Fighter. Before getting into the details of the update, I want to share my experience in developing the game. This is my first complete game and has definitely been a challenge. I have made mistakes and at times made wrong decisions regarding gameplay, but thanks to the enormous support and valuable feedback from many players, I continue to improve and learn. The goal of this update, based on the received feedback, is to make the gaming experience smoother and more balanced, although there is still a long way to go and a lot of content to add. I want to thank everyone for their patience and support in this project and reaffirm my commitment to continue working to improve and find the best ways to make EON Fighter a better game.

Now, let's see the changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/3f212e6f710d07baed0799c528b4b108c73e8b92.png[/img]

Restructuring of the upgrade system and game progress:

Upgrades are divided into three groups: ship upgrades, primary weapon upgrades, and secondary weapon upgrades. As weapons improve, they will level up, acquiring more projectiles, damage, or range. The most important upgrades, such as damage, health, and shield, are applied with numerical values instead of percentages to have more control and improve the balance between different ships. Mining upgrades have been removed.

All weapon damage variables and enemy health have been modified. The goal is for the player to have the possibility, if they wish, to boost secondary weapons and not rely solely on the primary weapon, increasing the variability of possible combinations.

Obtaining weapons is now independent of scenario progress. They have an indicator represented by a progress bar in the lower left corner. When filled, the player can choose to equip a secondary weapon, switch the primary weapon, or receive general upgrades. The speed of this counter varies depending on the game mode and, in the case of main missions, depends on the level of mining speed upgrades.
The functioning of secondary weapons no longer depends on the proximity of enemies. They now fire automatically whenever there are enemies on the scene, and their firing speed can be reduced through upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/42826dd1308d86d4d00715a1fe746a86fe700dd5.png[/img]

The visible circle around the ship now represents the range of the magnet.

New elements have been added to the UI to show the status of weapons, as well as a pilot avatar that will vary depending on the status of the ship. These elements will be improved in future updates.

The new "Expeditions" mode was introduced. This mode contains several levels, although only the first one is available for now. All levels will present new objectives, mechanics, game modes, enemies, and scenarios, with independent classifications per ship accessible from the menu. The first level is unlocked from the start, and the following ones will be unlocked according to the player's level.

The final list of songs was implemented, with a total of 20 tracks composed by Evgeny Bardyuzh (all incredible!).

Once again, thank you very much to everyone for your support, and I sincerely hope you enjoy this update.

Regards, Nicolas.

notes.title: Update 0.13.14:
notes.content:
Update 0.13.14:

Hello everyone! I am pleased to announce the new update 0.13.14 which includes the following improvements and changes:

An interactive tutorial has been added to guide new players in their first steps within the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/a29e4ec007968e3164d8446c4e9ec57767b11c00.png[/img]

I continue to work hard to optimize the game's performance to provide a smoother experience.

Regarding the artistic design, I have incorporated new sprites and adjusted some existing ones, with the goal of making each level more distinctive and attractive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/df366b2348edf91779801c3966bb597fd3c92c3c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/4fe686af29d92535c0d0d3b9881a53c051ef1076.png[/img]

The time limit in unlimited mode has been set to a maximum of 5 minutes per level.

I have also worked on balancing weapon damage, especially those without penetration, to increase their appeal in advanced levels.

I fixed an error in optional missions, where the timer did not always start at 60 seconds.

I want to thank everyone for their patience and ongoing support. As always, I invite you to share your feedback and suggestions to keep improving the game. Until the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.12.14!!
notes.content:
Update 0.12.14

Modifications to Endless Mode:

We have made significant changes to Endless Mode to improve the gameplay experience. Now, the first six waves will end with a unique boss, and from wave 7, additional bosses will be added until a maximum of ten bosses are on screen at once. As players progress, bosses and enemies in general will become more powerful. From wave 15, an additional 20% boss damage and 20% extra enemy health will be added each wave, gradually increasing difficulty.

In addition, we have added on-screen information indicating which wave the player is on, and enemy buffs will be displayed if there are any.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/2db73904fbe45288ff88a5ec8a57f0b1b58efe4d.png[/img]

Bug Fixes: 

In this update, we have also addressed several issues reported by the community, including:

Fixed an issue that prevented the in-game options screen from opening or closing properly when pressing the Escape key.

Removed controller vibration when playing with keyboard and mouse.

Fixed an issue that allowed some players to level up beyond the maximum level.

Fixed a crash issue in Sector 8.

Reduced cursor sensitivity in menus to prevent it from moving on its own in some cases.

Fixed an issue related to the cargo ship perk.

Increased the hit box size of low rate of fire weapons.

Fixed the hit box of mini bosses.

We continue to work on an improved tutorial to help new players better understand the game and get the most out of the gameplay elements. We appreciate all the feedback and suggestions from the community and invite you to keep contributing to enhance everyone's experience.

We hope you enjoy this update and continue to enjoy the game.

Thank you all for your support and patience!

Until next time!

notes.title: Update Note:
notes.content:
Update Note:

- Unlimited mode has been updated to allow players to reach up to 100 levels, instead of stopping at level 50 as previously experienced. Players can now continue playing and progressing beyond level 50.

- The tutorial window has been improved with the addition of arrows on the sides. This allows players to cycle through the different tutorial slides more easily, improving the overall tutorial experience.

notes.title: Update 0.12.13
notes.content:
Update 0.12.13

New Features:

Easy Mode: There is now an option for an Easy mode that reduces the number of enemies in the game so that new players can become more accustomed to the gameplay. It is also a good option for those who want a less intense experience. By default, Easy mode is enabled, but players can disable it by clicking on the corresponding option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/115801b752f2e8f214efa8993f8bea09c5b2a8ec.png[/img]

Gameplay Changes:

Increased amount of money per level: Players will now receive more money for each level completed. This will allow them to acquire upgrades and equipment more easily.

Reduced drift of the spaceship: When the spaceship stops moving, it now slides less. This will allow players to have greater control and precision in the movement of the spaceship.

We hope you enjoy the changes! As always, we appreciate your suggestions to continue improving the game. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update 0.12.12 is here!
notes.content:
Update 0.12.12 is here!

For players with low-resource computers or integrated graphics, we've added a new "LOW RESOLUTION MODE" option in the game settings. This mode reduces the game's resolution to improve performance while maintaining a higher resolution for text and user interface elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/e8434fc89680363312296fd0f0c94ccda9b06218.png[/img]

We've also adjusted the behavior of the new weapon cooling system, making it more predictable and consistent.

To prevent accidental movements of the pointer, we've reduced the sensitivity of controllers in the menu.
These improvements are a work in progress, and we will continue to optimize performance for all hardware configurations. Your opinions and suggestions are important to us as we continue to refine the game.

In upcoming updates, we will add more visual options, such as windowed mode and borderless, which have been frequently requested by our players.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 0.11.12!
notes.content:
Update 0.11.12!

I have received a lot of player feedback regarding weapon overheating, which is why I have implemented a new overheating system:

Previously, if the weapon overheated, it became disabled until it cooled down completely. Now, we have changed that. From now on, if the weapon overheats, it will not be completely disabled, but the firing rate will be significantly reduced. This means that players will not be completely defenseless, but they will have to be more strategic in their use of the weapon and take overheating into account to optimize its effectiveness.

Additionally, we have added a new gameplay mechanism. Just when the weapon overheats, a green marker will appear and an alarm will sound for half a second. If the player releases the fire button and fires again during that time, they will receive a special bonus and the weapon will cool down completely. This will allow players to quickly recover from overheating and get back into action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/bb0ccf462245bcdc57c53d56f3298f6e8a27df38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/4591373d16579525605cf1cfeae2646d97502080.png[/img]

By default, this new system will be enabled. However, if you prefer the previous system, you can change it from the menu options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/8e03bb74fcb5331e725d2677d1aef3993bfea57e.png[/img]

I want to thank everyone for their comments and criticism. I remind you that the main objective of this Early Access stage is to know your opinions, try new things, and know what you like and what you don't. In that sense, as always, I invite you to share your opinions and what you think about this new mechanism. They are very important to continue the development!

notes.title: Update 0.10.11
notes.content:
Update 0.10.11:

New Features:

5 new secondary weapons have been added to the game. These weapons offer new ways to take down enemies and provide players with additional options to customize their playstyle. Each weapon has unique stats and effects that can be explored and experimented with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/342f03673fb752d4f08c17cb9f7d4db01eedc1e8.png[/img]

A re-roll system has been added, which allows players to re-roll their weapon options for a small cost. This feature can be useful when a player is unhappy with their current weapon options and wants to try something new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/fbe9b3bad02056ebfb73ab540ca0b6d80d505ae4.png[/img]

Instructions on how to unlock weapons are now available. This provides players with a clear understanding of how to obtain new weapons and encourages them to explore the game's content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/74d09f35304b6d5d099d850197d4b3307e710f0d.png[/img]

A new pop-up box will appear when a weapon is unlocked, saying "NEW WEAPON UNLOCKED." This feature adds a sense of excitement and accomplishment when players unlock a new weapon.

Balancing Changes:

The cooldown system has been buffed based on player feedback. The cooldown was previously too punishing, especially when there were many enemies around. The heat resistance max has been increased by 30%, and the cooldown update now provides a 15% increase. This means that players now have more time to prevent overheating, and it feels less disruptive. 

Several bug fixes and balancing changes have been made to improve gameplay. These changes have been made based on player feedback and aim to create a more enjoyable and engaging experience for players.

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy the update and continue to enjoy playing the game.

notes.title: Welcome to Update 0.9.11!
notes.content:
Welcome to Update 0.9.11! We're thrilled to announce some exciting new features and improvements that we think you'll love.

Firstly, we've added 15 new perks to the game, including 8 unique ones that are tailored to each ship. These perks offer even more ways to customize your gameplay experience, and we can't wait for you to try them out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/9316841e9e77fbd21ad50ed7df0f3ac4b0add4cb.png[/img]

In addition, we've included a tutorial introduction at the start of the first level, making it easier than ever for new players to dive right into the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/c45517087d02c51760ec6b575c14188ef0322221.png[/img]

But that's not all - we've made some major modifications to the "Conflict Zone" game mode. You'll now progress through levels where you have to complete your loadout before taking on a mini boss and earning valuable resources. Each level has a time limit of 3 minutes, but don't worry - if you decide to continue to the next level, you'll receive an additional 3 minutes added to the remaining time from the previous level, as well as bonuses that can be obtained by destroying enemies to add more time to the clock. As you advance, the difficulty increases, so it's important to upgrade your ship to stay ahead of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/16968c54f2e04f1d87ce38ecef37c36679c4f170.png[/img]

We're always eager to hear feedback from our players, and we strive to make each game mode unique and in sync with the rest of the game. So please, don't hesitate to share your thoughts with us - your input helps us make the game better for everyone.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Update 0.8.11
notes.content:
Update 0.8.11 Changes in "Conflict Zone" 

The “Conflict Zone" now plays similarly to the normal missions where you mine for resources. In this case, you will get mechanical parts. 

Every time you have a full load, the cargo ship will arrive and you will have to choose: 

1 - Exit the area with the resources you gathered at that time. 

2 - Stay in the area and continue mining. Staying will grant you a 15% increase in extraction speed, but if you die while harvesting, you will lose 50% of all resources you have collected up to that point, and it goes without saying that enemies will be more powerful. and more difficult. It's your choice! 
You can stay in this mode for as long as you want, or rather, for as long as you can.

I hope you like the changes! Remember to keep giving me your comments and suggestions, it is very important to keep improving EON FIGHTER!

notes.title: Update 0.8.10! New upgrade system and more!
notes.content:
Update 0.8.10! New upgrade system and more!

The system of leveling and selection of weapons in game has been completely rearranged!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/1bd9029b210c7e35176c9d38e877e36c73d6c1b7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/7157583b8ee9f122fec1223467aafe8a737753c7.png[/img]

Upgrades are now split between ship, primary, and secondary weapons. In this way,  you will be able to improve every aspect of your entire arsenal, and you will have a much greater range of possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/9ad6eebf1ef9b80ce7efb52645a848dadc2c162d.png[/img]

In "Conflict Zone" mode, satellites will no longer give shield or damage bonuses, instead they will give mechanical parts. In turn, when you destroy a mini boss, it will only leave you a weapon bonus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/4dd7f76ca66ede1378386e7f58741c184ae3514c.png[/img]

On the other hand, if you die in "Conflict Zone" you will lose all the money and mechanical parts you have collected up to that point. However, every 5 minutes you will have a chance to escape in a cargo ship that will only be available for 45 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/9f09eb5f3078c7bfca37156001b6cad803f7af7d.png[/img]

If you decide not to escape and continue the level, the bonuses in money and mechanical parts will be higher, but remember that it will be more difficult and you will have a higher chance of losing everything.

The last chance to escape will be at minute 30, if you survive long enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/5ea8fb706737d4b2cfc698181d26f5bdcfd10c48.png[/img]


I hope you enjoy the update!

I thank you all for your patience and I invite you to continue sharing your opinions, criticisms and suggestions to continue improving the experience!

notes.title: Update 0.7.10
notes.content:
Update 0.7.10

- Modified upgrades, now the limit is 100% spread over 20 levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/5e1d87c50e63fe29a9aed0d625db413d6b0665d9.png[/img]

With the increase in the number of upgrades, in addition to giving the player the ability to further enhance their ship, money becomes more important in the game. It will be important to take into account improvements such as cargo capacity, mineral value or mining speed, to optimize profits per level. I will be working more on the upgrades in the next updates.

- In sectors, primary weapon upgrades will now show three weapon options, instead of just one.

- In the selection of secondary weapons, a delay of one second was applied until the options can be selected. This is to avoid, especially in the "Conflict zone" for those who use a keyboard and mouse, that they select one by mistake.

I greatly appreciate the comments and suggestions.

I hope you enjoy the update, and I invite you to leave me your comments or suggestions to continue improving the experience!

notes.title: Update 0.7.9! New mode, enemies, weapons and more!
notes.content:
Update 0.7.9! New mode, enemies, weapons and more!

1.A new mode has arrived!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/ff45164c14adac7265565230c44de23981309973.png[/img]

Conflict Zone: Destroy as many enemies as you can, and survive as long as you can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/509ee681d3cb268e8e72e00c5c60be9d3763913d.png[/img]

In this new mode, there is no time limit. The goal is to resist while destroying as many enemies as possible.
You will be able to sabotage enemy communications to gain shield and damage bonuses. You will also have nuclear bombs available, which will only go off if you kill a lot of enemies in a short time.
Through 4 new levels, you will have to face 24 new mini bosses that will make the task challenging, but will give great rewards to continue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/8b1f5b1e3cc96632800833088aed2f143cf406fe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/a24964bb0a0a431ecfb1b7731b1f58f51ee80430.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/d37094a7cc4d29bb3f1747c24122b4da458f8c9b.png[/img]

2.Weapons update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/53d3180c1a0c5757eafb91a4d6a383f736631b5f.png[/img]

8 new weapons were added, 4 main and 4 secondary. These will be unlocked after completing the Refinery and Extraction missions.  If you have already completed these missions, the weapons will be unlocked directly.

Explosive bullets, the swarm of missiles and much more for you to discover and enjoy the experience.

Additionally, when a ship levels up, it will now add a 2% bonus damage per level, with a maximum at level 20 of 40%.

Many thanks to everyone, especially "GamerGrill" who suggested many of the changes being added today.

I invite you to continue sending your comments and suggestions, without a doubt they are raising the gaming experience  a lot!

notes.title: Update 0.6.9 online! With perks, better ships and much more.
notes.content:
Update 0.6.9 online! With perks, better ships and much more.

Finally, the update is ready! There were several aspects of the game that needed to be improved a lot and these last few days I've been working hard to improve the experience.

First, I provided a whole new system to help you to track how much you have grown in the game.
- Menu of unlocked items

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/3c5860b9748a96bb511332c4395f72b49e92523e.png[/img]

Now they will be able to access and see the list of unlocked. Whenever you get a new weapon or perk, you'll see this button light up. Likewise, the unlocked object will be highlighted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/8bf83ad23306a219f8368370c1cdb4937a5f8fdd.png[/img]

Not all the weapons and perks are available yet. I am going to add more of them by the week.

- Visual improvement of ships

Every time your ship levels up, you will be able to see how its appearance changes up to level 20.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/928967acc633e2bcb47159a7596a3fbb7f447265.png[/img]

Second, the operation of the secondary weapon needed to give information to the player, to make it more predictable and understand how it works:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/d1f38ceb746031478733ed93498233688264e32b.png[/img]

- When the player equips a secondary weapon, a circle will appear around the ship. If an enemy enters within the area of this circle, the secondary weapon system is activated. If the weapon is ready to fire, you will see a progress bar and when it is complete, the weapon will fire. On the contrary, while it is recharging, the bar will turn red and you will see an icon until it is finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/2b0c64794ddaabf09b9507b059db3e56b081051d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/b3e2d8bebb9e1875fe1ced9044e8de762472e10d.png[/img]

On the other hand, perks continue to be added. Many perks will be unique to each ship and will have a recharge timer, only activating every certain amount of time.
For this, when the player selects perks for his ship, these can be seen on the HUD and if any are not available at that moment, the icon will turn red.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/7b3703f8f30224c9315fe913b68bc814db4ce471.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/835e1b27145c1143863d1848bf07ff8c38a92433.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/4523ae15b4e86c2d3a630d1c49e7ec0772ce5c65.png[/img]

I thank you all for your patience, comments, suggestions, and I invite you all to continue leaving your comments, criticisms, and suggestions. They are very important for development!

I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: The day has arrived! EON Fighter version 0.1.0 is online!
notes.content:
Finally, after a lot of work, the day came. In this post I wanted to tell you about the state of the game at launch:

- 8 different ships, each with different characteristics and passive improvements.
- 10 primary weapons.
- 13 secondary weapons.
- 10 modifiers during the game.
- 10 permanent upgrades to buy.
- 10 different sectors with unique scenarios and obstacles.
- 9 perks with important improvements.
- 4 factions of enemies.
- New “Simulator” mode where the goal is to survive as long as possible against a growing number of elements, within an area that shrinks over time.
- “High Activity” mode, when the player unlocks all 10 sectors, and destroys 10 motherships, every time they enter the game 5 random sectors will be put into this mode, having almost twice as many enemies and much more challenging motherships .
- Excellent soundtrack by Evgeny Bardyuzha, whom I thanks a lot for his contribution, it certainly takes the game to another level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/0def30eeb05f2a6e773f4652c5fb4fc59b73daad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/6eff84161045f01ad9d5b4b36eed5467ae1e4f2d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944441/019ff75d991db235331f7aaf255b636b8f0debea.png[/img]

However this is just beginning! Starting today and during the early access period I will be adding a lot more content and polishing the game.
Two modes that are already in development. “Escort missions” and “Enemy refineries” that are sure to be a lot of fun for those who like to destroy enemies!

And of course, weapons! Lots of weapons!

I sincerely hope you enjoy the game, it has been a very laborious but also very rewarding process.

Please feel free to contact me via Discord if you find anything wrong, have criticism or suggestions.
https://discord.gg/PncbAvSazk

Thank you very much to all!
